idea.title: Printable digital planners on Etsy at $9

source.text: Selling printable digital planners on Etsy at $9 each. Launch country US, budget $300, 8 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions.

idea.solution: Printable digital planners (PDF downloads) sold on Etsy
assumptions: Customer assumed to be US Etsy shoppers looking for planners (not stated)
No paid design tools; Canva free plan
Organic Etsy search plus optional Etsy Ads as the channel

confidence.note: Most demand and ad numbers come from seller-tool blogs; real Etsy Ads data from a 14-day test would raise it.

gross_margin.note: About 85% at $9 after Etsy fees ($1.31/sale); capped from 4.5 by R4 because LTV:CAC is below 1.

ltv_cac.note: Paid CAC about $15 ($0.30 CPC / 2% conversion) vs LTV about $9.2: 0.62.

pricing_power.note: Comparable printables sell at $2.79-$6.01 and full-year planners are free.

build_effort.note: Canva plus AI builds a sellable planner in 2-3 hours.

skills_match.note: No stated design or Etsy SEO experience; both learnable in weeks.

capital_needed.note: $0.20 per listing; the $300 budget is barely touched.

time_to_mvp.note: A listing can be live in under a week.

channel_readiness.note: No audience; Etsy page 1 is 55% paid and held by shops with thousands of reviews (R5: no_distribution).

search_demand.note: Over 1M listings target 'digital planner': buyers search it at scale.

trend.note: Planner searches strong in 2025, but Etsy marketplace buyers fell 3.4% in 2025.

willingness_to_pay.note: Buyers pay, but only $2-$7 per printable, and free versions abound.

free_alternatives.note: Passion Planner gives a full 2026 printable free; Canva has free templates (R1).

differentiation.note: No stated edge; any layout is copied within days (R3).

legal_regulatory.note: Basic business law plus font and template licensing and AI disclosure.

platform_dependency.note: 100% Etsy: search, payments and AI rules changed again in 2026-10.

market_risk.note: Planning is a recurring yearly need with a January peak.

skills.note: No design, SEO or marketing track record stated.

assets.note: No audience, email list or network stated.

interest.note: Stated goal is side income; no stated passion for planning.

tam.reasoning: US daily planner products $85.5M in 2025 (Fortune Business Insights); one source only, digital share unknown, so treated as an estimate

som.reasoning: base case 15 sales/month x $9 x 12 months

demand_trend.reasoning: planner searches high in 2025 (Accio) vs Etsy marketplace active buyers -3.4% in 2025 (10-K)

expected_lifetime.reasoning: one-off download; assume 20% buy a second item

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: midpoint of the 1-3% Etsy benchmark (Listify AI, 2026); a new shop with no reviews likely converts lower

cac.reasoning: Etsy Ads CPC $0.30 (midpoint of $0.10-$0.50, InsightAgent 2026) / 2% conversion

payback_months.reasoning: lifetime gross profit $9.23 is below CAC $15 on paid ads: it never pays back

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: 20 listings x $0.20 renewed every 4 months = $1/month; no paid tools

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $1 fixed / $7.69 gross profit per sale = 0.13, rounded up to 1 (organic only; paid sales lose money)

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 1 week to build and list, 2-6 weeks for a new listing's first organic sale (Etsy community reports)

verdict.launch_reason: Only target market given; Etsy's largest buyer base.
verdict.cheapest_test: List one $19 niche bundle and post 20 Pinterest pins in 7 days; stop if under 150 listing views.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 150 listing views by day 7 -> stop
0 sales after 500 listing views by day 30 -> stop
Fewer than 3 sales by day 60 -> archive the shop
Etsy Ads ROAS below 1.0 after $30 spent -> turn ads off

rescue.change: Pick one narrow ICP (e.g. homeschool parents), sell a $19 bundle, and drive traffic with Pinterest instead of Etsy Ads.
rescue.why: Lifts pricing_power and ltv_cac above 1 and gives a free channel; fixes R6, not R2 or the saturated wave.
rescue.effort: 2 weeks to launch, 3-6 months of pinning
rescue.requires: 8 h/week of Pinterest pins and one niche you can describe in the buyer's words

rescue.change: Sell custom-branded planner templates as a done-for-you service to coaches and therapists at $150+.
rescue.why: Breaks the $2-$7 price anchor and the Etsy dependency; LTV:CAC well above 3 with direct outreach.
rescue.requires: Cold outreach and design skills the user has not shown yet

narrative.answer: **NO-GO.** Building costs nothing, but **no channel** pays back: a $9 planner earns $9.2 per buyer while an Etsy Ads buyer costs about $15, against 1M+ listings and free full-year planners.
tldr: Margin is fine (**85%**); distribution is the killer.
Paid CAC about **$15** vs LTV $9.2: every ad-driven sale loses money.
Organic means beating 1M+ listings and shops with thousands of reviews, with no edge.

key_findings.title: Every paid customer loses money
key_findings.detail: Etsy Ads at $0.10-$0.50 per click and a 1-3% conversion put CAC near **$15**, above the **$9.2 LTV**.

key_findings.title: A million listings, page 1 bought
key_findings.detail: **1,044,640 listings** target 'digital planner' and 55% of page 1 is paid placement.

key_findings.title: The market price is $3-6, or free
key_findings.detail: Comparable printables sell at **$2.79-$6.01** and Passion Planner gives a full 2026 planner away free.

narrative.recommendation: Do not open a generic $9 planner shop. If you want to try, spend 7 days testing one niche $19 bundle with Pinterest traffic and stop at the first kill criterion.
narrative.steelman: Etsy hands you **86.5M buyers**, a near-zero build cost and an impulse purchase; some shops do earn steadily. True, but those shops won with years of reviews or an audience, which this user does not have.
narrative.lesson: Low build cost is not an opportunity: when anyone can make it in an hour, **distribution** is the whole business.

premortem.cause: Listings sit unseen under 1M+ competitors; the shop gets a handful of views a day and no sales.
premortem.early_signal: Under 150 listing views in the first 7 days

premortem.cause: Etsy Ads bring sales, but each costs more than the $7.69 it earns.
premortem.early_signal: ROAS below 1.0 after $30 of ad spend

premortem.cause: Copycat AI listings undercut the $9 price within weeks.
premortem.early_signal: Look-alikes at $2-$4 in search within 30 days

changes.what: AI generators cut a printable planner to 5-10 minutes, flooding supply.
Etsy marketplace active buyers fell 3.4% to 86.5M.
Etsy tightened Creativity Standards for digital items.
Etsy emailed sellers new AI-use rules and image requirements.

why_now.note: Supply exploded and the buyer base shrank: the window closed for generic planners.

icp.who: US Etsy shoppers who want a specific planner (e.g. homeschool, teacher, ADHD) and print at home
icp.pays_for_today: $2.79-$6.01 per printable on Etsy, or nothing (Passion Planner free PDF)
icp.trigger: New year, new school year, or a life change (new job, new baby)

free_alternative.evidence: Passion Planner gives away a **full 2026 weekly printable** PDF; Canva offers free customizable planner templates.

strong_competitor.evidence: Shops on page 1 for 'digital planner pdf' have a **median of 6,400 reviews** (Listify AI, 2026).

graveyard.evidence: Searched 'quit selling digital planners', 'not worth it': no named shop post-mortem found; only anecdotal no-sales threads.

no_distribution.evidence: Paid CAC **about $15** vs LTV $9.2; organically, **55% of page 1** is paid placement and new shops report about 5 views a day.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Etsy fees total about $1.31 on a $9 sale: **85% gross margin**.

weak_demand.evidence: 'Digital weekly planner' searches peaked at 88 in 2025-09; demand exists, though Etsy buyers fell 3.4% in 2025.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: **Single-platform** business: Etsy changed AI rules on 2026-10-22 and removed 1.5M listings for IP in 2024.

saturated_wave.evidence: **1,044,640 listings** target 'digital planner'; AI generators promise a printable in 5-10 minutes.

customer.segment: US Etsy shoppers looking for printable planners
customer.pain: Wants a planner layout that fits their routine without buying a bound planner
customer.today: Free PDFs, Canva templates or $3-$6 Etsy printables

competitors.name: Gumroad Canva planner bundles (Toekzie Digital and others)

scenarios.name: Pessimistic
scenarios.note: Organic only, new shop; fees $2.62 + $1 listings

scenarios.name: Optimistic
scenarios.note: Fees $78.60 + $1 listings + $60 ads; needs page-1 rank

risks.risk: Shop suspension or listing removal after an IP report (fonts, templates)
risks.mitigation: Use only commercially licensed fonts and own layouts

risks.risk: Etsy AI and creativity rule changes delist AI-assisted products
risks.mitigation: Disclose AI use and keep design files as proof of creative input
Niche bundles at a higher price, not generic singles

risks.risk: Buyers cannot download in the Etsy app, causing support and refunds
risks.mitigation: Add download instructions to the listing and the thank-you message

test_plan.step: Pick one niche and read 30 Etsy reviews of its top 5 listings for unmet needs
Build one $19 bundle in Canva and 5 listings with niche keywords
Post 20 fresh Pinterest pins linking to the listings

test_plan.verify: 150+ listing views and 10+ favorites, or stop
